dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you to gather inspiration for me!

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: If I delay again, I bet Miss Moriko'll... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: I admire how these novelists manage to stay so creative, but I wish they wouldn't forget to take good care of their health...

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Can you really see the eyes of the two statues in Luhua Pool clearly from afar?

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Port Ormos is so lively! How I wish I could be there myself...

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: I hope that this author's new work will sell well. He has really spent a lot of time and effort on this...

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: The author of The Rockeater has always been in good health. Archon even knows how he stays that way...

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Agh... Miss Moriko actually came to ask me if we should go to the desert to play...

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Seriously, though... what's there to play "with" in the desert...?

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Phew. That romance novel author finally agreed to give this some more thought.

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: But I still have to do that illustration... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Whew, it's finally done. I have to catch up with the others...

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}? Haha, you're just in time. I'm chasing after the powerful "Great Mujina Youkai" with some new comrades I met.

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: Why, from those comrades of mine, of course. Apparently, this extremely powerful youkai has been wreaking havoc across rural Inazuma. Whenever it comes across a child who has snuck outside to play, it starts teasing them.

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: You know, things like tying their shoelaces together, or turning mud and roots into fruits on a tree then tricking the children into eating them...

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: Sometimes, it even dispatches a few mini mujina and has them turn into parents or teachers to frighten the children.

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: Anyway, there's no way I'm gonna let such a formidable youkai run loose.

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: If you have time, why not join us on our pursuit of the Great Mujina Youkai?

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: Oh? So you know Yoimiya too? What a coincidence...

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: Anyway, now's not the time for chitchat. Yoimiya and the others are looking for the Great Mujina Youkai's tracks up ahead.

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: It's my responsibility to bring up the rear, and ensure the Great Mujina doesn't attack us from behind in a fit of rage.

choices.text: Could one of them be Yoimiya?
Where did you hear that name?

dialogues.speaker: Matsuzaka
dialogues.text: It's not here either...

dialogues.speaker: Saika
dialogues.text: Uhh, Yoimiya... A—Are you sure the Great Mujina's nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Saika
dialogues.text: If so, d—does that mean we're in its territory now? Oh, I—I'm scared...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Don't be scared! There's a whole group of us here, and we brought lots of fireworks too. If anything, the Great Mujina Youkai is the one that should be afraid!

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: Yep, and Tartaglia is watching our backs! There's nothing to be afraid of...

response.speaker: Matsuzaka
response.text: Ahh! Yoimiya!

response.speaker: Saika
response.text: Aah! Yoimiya! Yoimiya!

response.speaker: Iwao
response.text: Tartaglia, help! It's the Great Mujina Youkai!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: #That's not a youkai! It's {NICKNAME}. You've met {F#her}{M#him} before, remember?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you tracking the Great Mujina Youkai?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: That's right, the Great Mujina Youkai has been getting pretty bold lately. It's even starting to trick people in broad daylight.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Not only did it scribble all over Iwao's homework and get him in trouble at school, it also stole Saika's snacks and broke Matsuzaka's toys.

choices.text: (Sounds like the kids are the ones behind all this...)

response.speaker: Iwao
response.text: Yeah, that's why we're here with Yoimiya! We're gonna chase that Great Mujina Youkai away for good!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: About Tartaglia...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh, him. Um... We specially invited him to be our "Anti-Mujina Specialist."

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Fireworks can only do so much... They may scare it away, but if we want it gone for good, we need the help of a real professional.

response.speaker: Iwao
response.text: Tartaglia is so cool! He becomes like a watery blur when he fights. All you hear is WOOSH WOOSH POW! And then all the monsters are defeated!

response.speaker: Iwao
response.text: *sigh* If only he could teach me a few of his moves...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Well, why don't we ask him after we've taken down the Great Mujina Youkai!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But right now, our priority is to search for evidence of this youkai and trace it back to its lair.

response.speaker: Iwao
response.text: And then... we'll be able to tackle it head on! Right, Yoimiya?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: That's right. We'll defeat it together!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Shh, keep your voice down. Don't let Iwao and the others hear you.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: He's one of the Fatui Harbingers, right? Sakujirou mentioned him to me before... and I heard about everything that happened in Liyue, too.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I know that he might be dangerous... But he saved Iwao, and the kids all warmed up to him right away. He even happily agreed to help us find the Great Mujina Youkai.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I've heard that the Fatui are all really scary and dangerous... You know, like the kind of people you'd want to avoid the moment you lay eyes on them.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But Tartaglia isn't like that at all, he's really nice to the kids. He even had an in-depth discussion with them about the Great Mujina Youkai's combat skills...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: From my point of view, it doesn't seem like he's just pretending to be nice. I think the kids would agree — they believe he's a kind, reliable grown-up.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: No matter what Tartaglia's true identity might be... he's doing something good right now, and I think he deserves to be treated accordingly.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But don't worry, I'm not gonna let my guard down!

choices.text: Just let me know if you run into any trouble.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Okay, thanks! It's great to have you around.

choices.text: No need to worry, I can deal with him.
(It's probably the kids pulling pranks on each other...)
Look! It's the Great Mujina Youkai!

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: I see... Yeah, this will make a wonderful gift.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Yae Publishing House released several new novels recently. Shigeru told me that a good number of them are children's fairy tales — perfect for reading aloud to kids.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Oh, and Ogura Mio has just received a new batch of silk. She might've come up with some new kimono designs.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: But do you still remember what size your sister wears? The kimono might look a little off if you get the size wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Lemme think for a second, I've bought clothes for her plenty of times before... That's it, I believe it's...

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Ah, hold on — she's having her growth spurt at the moment... She probably doesn't fit into anything I've bought her in the past anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: It's okay if you don't know her exact size. You can always just buy her a few bolts of silk instead! Who knows, maybe she'd like that even better.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Oh! And why don't you take some fireworks with you as well? I just finished creating a new design that's both pretty and relatively quiet. I'm sure your siblings are gonna love it!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hmm... What else should you get them... lemme think.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you two doing?

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Yoimiya was just recommending some Inazuman specialties for me to bring back as souvenirs.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: If it weren't for her, I wouldn't have the slightest idea what to buy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So how did you two meet?

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Hehe, talk about a coincidence. I happened to be passing through Inazuma while taking care of some... work. I wanted to grab some presents for my younger siblings while I was here, but I couldn't decide on what to buy.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Teucer once told me that he wanted to hold an Onikabuto, so I decided to go catch one of those little bugs first.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: As I was looking for Onikabuto in the forest, I saw a child playing all on his own... and he was headed straight for a camp of monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: So I stopped the child, dealt with the monsters, and then he led me back to Yoimiya.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: After that... Well, I was designated as the "Anti-Mujina Specialist."

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: It's a shame the kids' parents came and took everyone back home, saying that they'd had enough adventures outside. *sigh* Our hunt for the youkai came to an abrupt end.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: The ship I'll be leaving on will arrive in Inazuma in just a few days. Then it'll be my turn to go back home.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Oh, by the way, Yoimiya, can you recommend a few local beverages as well?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Local beverages? But you're going to be on a ship for quite some time, right? Beverages spoil easily... How about bringing some snacks with a longer shelf life? Something like Tricolor Dango or Sakura Mochi, for example.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Saika loves Tricolor Dango, but the adults in her family always scold her for eating too many and spoiling her appetite.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Teucer used to be like that too. After having too many snacks, he'd refuse to eat his meals and end up getting yelled at by Father...

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Anyways, thanks Yoimiya. I gotta make sure I have enough Mora for all this.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Two kimonos, three bolts of silk, one novel, five boxes of snacks... Oh, and the Onikabuto as well.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: You really care a lot about your family, Tartaglia...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh, you mean with Tartaglia? Nah, everything's fine. He took great care of the kids and even promised Iwao he'd teach him a few moves with a sword.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Though, I have to say... It's amazing you have so many friends from all over the world.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: You're so lucky... I'd travel all across the world too if I had the chance. I want to see all that there is to see and make friends with all kinds of people... I would even go on adventures with them, just like you do...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But for now, I have to stay home with my pops, so I won't be traveling far anytime soon.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Don't keep it a secret next time you come to Inazuma, okay? Just be sure to visit Naganohara Fireworks first and tell me all about the amazing things you've seen on your journey.
